headline: CLE @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 3.42 at PHI 3.81, with a projected total of 7.23. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved +0.09 runs while PHI moved -0.15, changing the projected margin by +0.23 runs. NRFI probability rose +17.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cristopher Sánchez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Kyle Schwarber, Alec Bohm, Travis Bazzana, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García, Kyle Schwarber because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
